literal_meaning: হাতে পাওয়া (হাতে গ্রহণ করা বা প্রাপ্তি)
figurative_meaning_en: To come into possession or control
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে অবশেষে সেই সম্পত্তিটি হাতে পেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He finally got his hands on that property.
The job opportunity has come into his possession.
note: This idiom reflects everyday acquisition in Bengali linguistic tradition.
